annotations.title: Find a covered contract by name

description: Find a covered contract's address from words the user gave: its name (e.g. 'Steakhouse USDC'), its asset symbol (e.g. 'WETH') or part of its address. Returns up to `limit` matches with address, name, asset and family. Use it when the user names a vault, a lending market (e.g. 'Compound USDC') or a coin instead of giving an address, then call get_control_state with the address.

query.description: Words that must all appear in the contract's name, asset symbol, family or address. Case does not matter.

name: search_covered_contracts
title: Find a covered contract by name
